recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 下深藍色的淋巴細胞區之間，有一片片淡粉紅、細胞質豐富的組織球區（右下角最明顯），在淋巴結中呈擴張竇狀分佈；低倍下 Rosai-Dorfman disease 常呈這種深淺交錯的外觀，需高倍確認 emperipolesis。
features: Low-power view with dense sheets of small lymphocytes interrupted by pale eosinophilic zones
Pale zones (especially lower right) composed of large histiocytes with abundant pink cytoplasm, in a sinusoidal-like distribution
Interspersed plasma cells and small vessels within the lymphoid areas
No follicles with germinal centers evident in this field
Emperipolesis is not resolvable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power sections show a lymphoid tissue in which sheets of small lymphocytes and plasma cells alternate with pale eosinophilic areas composed of large histiocytes with abundant cytoplasm, imparting a light-and-dark pattern suggestive of expanded sinuses. No well-formed germinal centers are identified in this field. Emperipolesis and nuclear details cannot be evaluated at this magnification. The architecture is suggestive of Rosai-Dorfman disease, to be confirmed on high power and with S100 immunostaining.

ddx.vs: Sinuses contain smaller S100-negative histiocytes without emperipolesis and normal nodal architecture is preserved.
Sinus involvement by grooved CD1a+ cells with eosinophils and necrosis rather than large pale S100+ histiocytes with emperipolesis.

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma with histiocyte-rich background
ddx.vs: Contains CD30/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells and often capsular fibrosis, identified on high power.
Epithelioid histiocytes form compact granulomas with multinucleated giant cells, not loose sheets of large histiocytes with engulfed lymphocytes.
